post.description:
Create a new eBay description for a specific issue.

This endpoint generates a new eBay description for the specified issue using
either Groq or OpenRouter APIs. The provider is automatically detected from
the model name unless explicitly specified.

**Provider Detection:**
- Models with "/" (e.g., "anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet") → OpenRouter
- Simple model names (e.g., "llama-3.3-70b-versatile") → Groq

**Supported Providers:**
- **Groq**: Requires GROQ_API_KEY environment variable
- **OpenRouter**: Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable

**Note**: This endpoint will fail with 409 if a description already exists
for the specified issue and model combination. Use PATCH to update existing
descriptions.

Raises:
    404: If the issue_id does not exist
    409: If description already exists for this issue+model combination
    429: If API rate limit is exceeded
    500: If API key is missing or other errors occur

get.description:
List all available LLM models from configured providers.

Returns a list of available models with metadata including:
- Model ID (used in API requests)
- Human-readable name
- Provider (Groq or OpenRouter)
- Context length (max tokens)
- Description
- Pricing information (OpenRouter only)

**Caching**: Results are cached for 1 hour to reduce API calls.
Use `force_refresh=true` to bypass cache.

**Providers**:
- **Groq**: Free tier models (requires GROQ_API_KEY)
- **OpenRouter**: Premium models (requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY)

If a provider's API key is not set, that provider's models will not be included
(or a hardcoded fallback list will be returned).

Raises:
    400: If provider parameter is invalid

schema.description: Filter by provider: 'groq' or 'openrouter'. If not specified, returns models from both providers.

patch.description:
Update an existing eBay description.

This endpoint allows you to either:
1. **Manually update** the description text by providing `description` field
2. **Regenerate** the description using AI by setting `regenerate=true`

When regenerating, you can optionally specify a different model or provider.
The original model will be used if not specified.

**Provider Detection:**
- Models with "/" (e.g., "anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet") → OpenRouter
- Simple model names (e.g., "llama-3.3-70b-versatile") → Groq

**Supported Providers:**
- **Groq**: Requires GROQ_API_KEY environment variable
- **OpenRouter**: Requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable

Raises:
    400: If request validation fails
    404: If description_id does not exist
    429: If API rate limit is exceeded (when regenerating)
    500: If API key is missing or other errors occur (when regenerating)

parameters.name: description_id

schema.description: ID of the description to update
schema.title: Description Id

parameters.description: ID of the description to update

post.description:
Regenerate an eBay description for a specific issue using Groq API.

**DEPRECATED**: Use POST /ebay-descriptions to create new descriptions
or PATCH /ebay-descriptions/{id} to update existing ones. This endpoint
only supports Groq and will be removed in a future version.

This endpoint generates a new eBay description for the specified issue.
By default, it will skip generation if a description already exists for
the specified model unless `force=true` is set.

The generated description is saved to the database and returned in the response.

**Note**: Requires GROQ_API_KEY environment variable to be set.

Raises:
    404: If the issue_id does not exist
    409: If description exists and force=false
    429: If Groq API rate limit is exceeded
    500: If API key is missing or other errors occur
